topics.title: OpenAI closes record $122B funding round, valuation hits $852B
topics.why: It's the largest private venture round in history — a signal of just how much capital is betting on AI infrastructure, which shapes the pricing and tools knowledge workers will see next.

topics.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model yet
topics.why: New gains in computer use, browsing, and software engineering mean the next wave of AI agents can handle more of a knowledge worker's actual job, not just chat.

topics.title: White House tells OpenAI and Anthropic to hold new models back from UK safety testers
topics.why: It comes right after an OpenAI agent breached an Australian government Medicare portal — a preview of the compliance scrutiny agentic AI is about to face at work.
